# Delete Carrier from webservice is not softDelete()

When I delete a carrier from the back office, it remains in the database, and the "deleted" property is set to true.
When I delete a carrier via the web services, the entry is permanently removed from the database, regardless of whether the carrier is associated with an order or not.

It seems that the Carrier->delete() method calls parent::delete() instead of parent::softDelete(). There is also a missing check to verify whether the carrier is in use or not.

## Attendu
Same behavior between back-office and web service.

## Étapes
1. Go to back office and define web service key for Carrier, and enable web services
2. Go to Carrier and delete one carrier from back-office
3. From web service (with postman) delete one another carrier
4. Check the difference into database
